container_info.description:
This project aims to automate the process of connecting to public GitHub repositories, ingesting their codebases, and generating comprehensive documentation for the ingested code. The system will streamline code understanding, onboarding, and maintenance by providing clear, structured, and up-to-date documentation derived directly from source code. The project is intended for developers, technical writers, and organizations seeking to improve codebase transparency and reduce manual documentation effort.

Key outcomes include automated code parsing, documentation generation, and integration with GitHub APIs, ensuring scalability and adaptability for various programming languages and repository structures.
container_info.reasoning: The container is explicitly labeled as a frontend (WebDashboard) and the Dockerfile summary includes frontend toolchains and CLIs: nodejs, npm, yarn, typescript, create-react-app, @vue/cli, @angular/cli. For a web dashboard that integrates with GitHub and displays documentation, a SPA framework is appropriate. React (via create-react-app) is a lightweight, widely supported choice for building dashboards and fits the preinstalled tooling (create-react-app, node, npm, yarn, TypeScript).
requirements: nodejs (LTS) and npm or yarn - core runtime and package manager
create-react-app (or Vite) - minimal project scaffolding (CLI only)
TypeScript (optional) - if using typed code; only tsconfig and typescript package
react and react-dom - core framework runtime
basic build scripts in package.json (start, build) using the dev server
CI-friendly headless browser not required for basic operation (use dev server); if tests run, include jest (lightweight) and react-testing-library
git and curl - for connecting to GitHub and fetching repos (already present)
environment variables for GitHub token/config (no production secret manager)
minimal static file storage (container filesystem) for generated docs preview
lightweight HTTP proxy not required — use built-in dev server for headless operation

steps.name: environment
steps.description: Persist minimal global environment for Node tooling: export npm global bin into PATH via /etc/profile.d, set a guarded NODE_ENV default if unset, create the workspace directory, and write a .env.example documenting GITHUB_TOKEN. Verify node/npm exist and emit remediation guidance (commands) if versions are below flexible thresholds. Idempotent: will not overwrite existing profile unless content differs; will back up existing profile.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/test-project-ajay-8050-8163/WebDashboard(Frontend)"
PROFILE=/etc/profile.d/webdashboard_node.sh
sudo sh -c 'mkdir -p "${WORKSPACE}" && chown -R $(id -u):$(id -g) "${WORKSPACE}"' >/dev/null
# Ensure node and npm are present
if ! command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "ERROR: node not found. Remediation: install a compatible Node LTS (e.g. apt install -y nodejs) or use nvm." >&2; exit 2; fi
if ! command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "ERROR: npm not found. Remediation: install npm or use node package that bundles npm." >&2; exit 3; fi
NODE_V=$(node -v || true)
NPM_V=$(npm -v || true)
NODE_MAJOR=$(echo "$NODE_V" | sed -E 's/^v?([0-9]+).*/\1/' || echo 0)
NPM_MAJOR=$(echo "$NPM_V" | cut -d. -f1 || echo 0)
# Warn but allow if moderately old; fail only if extremely old (<16)
if [ "$NODE_MAJOR" -lt 16 ]; then echo "ERROR: Node version ${NODE_V} is too old. Remediation: update Node to >=16 (preferred >=18)." >&2; exit 4; fi
if [ "$NPM_MAJOR" -lt 6 ]; then echo "ERROR: npm version ${NPM_V} is older than expected. Remediation: npm install -g npm@latest or use apt to upgrade." >&2; exit 5; fi
# Resolve npm global bin
NPM_BIN=$(npm bin -g 2>/dev/null || echo "/usr/local/bin")
PROFILE_CONTENT="# WebDashboard frontend environment (generated)
export PATH=\"${NPM_BIN}:\$PATH\"
: \"NODE_ENV default\"
if [ -z \"\${NODE_ENV-}\" ]; then export NODE_ENV=development; fi
"
# write profile idempotently with sudo; backup if exists and differs
if sudo test -f "$PROFILE"; then
  if ! sudo cmp -s <(printf "%s" "$PROFILE_CONTENT") "$PROFILE"; then sudo cp "$PROFILE" "${PROFILE}.bak" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; sudo sh -c "printf '%s' \"$PROFILE_CONTENT\" > $PROFILE"; fi
else
  echo "$PROFILE_CONTENT" | sudo tee "$PROFILE" >/dev/null
fi
# validate profile readable in this shell (source) and ensure npm in PATH
# shellcheck disable=SC1090
. "$PROFILE" || true
if ! command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "ERROR: npm not on PATH even after sourcing profile." >&2; exit 6; fi
# create .env.example documenting GitHub token
ENV_EXAMPLE="$WORKSPACE/.env.example"
if [ ! -f "$ENV_EXAMPLE" ]; then cat > "$ENV_EXAMPLE" <<EOF
# Example env file for WebDashboard (do NOT store secrets here in production)
# GITHUB_TOKEN used for repository access
GITHUB_TOKEN=
NODE_ENV=development
EOF
fi

steps.name: scaffold
steps.description: Create a minimal React app in the workspace. Prefer preinstalled create-react-app if usable; otherwise fallback to npx create-react-app. If CRA is unavailable or fails, fallback to Vite. Only request the TypeScript template when tsconfig.json exists or when an explicit TS intent is detected; otherwise scaffold JS. When workspace is non-empty, scaffold into a temp dir then intelligently merge package.json (merge scripts and dependencies) and copy non-conflicting files; back up any overwritten config files.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/test-project-ajay-8050-8163/WebDashboard(Frontend)"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
# detect TS intent: existing tsconfig.json => prefer TS; otherwise JS default
USE_TS=false
if [ -f "$WORKSPACE/tsconfig.json" ]; then USE_TS=true; fi
# Prefer CRA binary if present
USE_CRA=false
if command -v create-react-app >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  CRA_BIN=$(command -v create-react-app)
  CRA_VER=$($CRA_BIN --version 2>/dev/null || true)
  # simple numeric parse; prefer CRA if present; do not rely solely on major
  if [ -n "$CRA_VER" ]; then USE_CRA=true; fi
fi
TMPDIR=
SCaffold_CMD=""
if [ -z "$(ls -A "$WORKSPACE")" ]; then
  # empty workspace: scaffold in-place
  if $USE_CRA; then
    if $USE_TS; then $CRA_BIN --template typescript . --use-npm --silent || exit 7; else $CRA_BIN . --use-npm --silent || exit 8; fi
  else
    if $USE_TS; then npx create-react-app . --template typescript --use-npm --silent || exit 9; else npx create-react-app . --use-npm --silent || exit 10; fi
  fi
else
  # non-empty workspace: scaffold into temp dir then merge
  TMPDIR=$(mktemp -d)
  if $USE_CRA; then
    if $USE_TS; then $CRA_BIN --template typescript "$TMPDIR" --use-npm --silent || { rm -rf "$TMPDIR"; exit 11; }; else $CRA_BIN "$TMPDIR" --use-npm --silent || { rm -rf "$TMPDIR"; exit 12; }; fi
  else
    if $USE_TS; then npx create-react-app "$TMPDIR" --template typescript --use-npm --silent || { rm -rf "$TMPDIR"; exit 13; }; else npx create-react-app "$TMPDIR" --use-npm --silent || { rm -rf "$TMPDIR"; exit 14; }; fi
  fi
  # Backup existing critical files
  for f in package.json package-lock.json yarn.lock; do [ -f "$WORKSPACE/$f" ] && cp -a "$WORKSPACE/$f" "$WORKSPACE/$f.bak" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; done
  # Merge package.json scripts/dependencies atomically using node
  if [ -f "$TMPDIR/package.json" ]; then
    node -e "const fs=require('fs'),W='$WORKSPACE',T='$TMPDIR';const wp=\
W+'/package.json',tp=T+'/package.json';if(fs.existsSync(tp)){const a=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(tp)),b=fs.existsSync(wp)?JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(wp)):{};b.scripts=b.scripts||{};b.dependencies=b.dependencies||{};Object.assign(b.scripts,a.scripts||{});Object.assign(b.dependencies,a.dependencies||{});fs.writeFileSync(wp,JSON.stringify(b,null,2));}else console.log('no tmp package.json');"
  fi
  # Copy non-conflicting files (do not overwrite existing files except allowed merges)
  (cd "$TMPDIR" && shopt -s dotglob; for p in * .[^.]*; do [ -e "$p" ] || continue; case "$p" in package.json|node_modules) continue ;; esac; if [ ! -e "$WORKSPACE/$p" ]; then cp -a "$p" "$WORKSPACE/"; fi; done)
  rm -rf "$TMPDIR"
fi
# ensure .static-docs exists
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE/.static-docs"
# ensure basic scripts exist in package.json
if [ -f package.json ]; then
  node -e "const p=require('./package.json');p.scripts=p.scripts||{};p.scripts.start=p.scripts.start||'react-scripts start';p.scripts.build=p.scripts.build||'react-scripts build';p.scripts.test=p.scripts.test||'react-scripts test';require('fs').writeFileSync('./package.json',JSON.stringify(p,null,2));"
fi

set -euo pipefail
# scaffold: create minimal React app in workspace, merge intelligently when non-empty

if [ -f "$PROFILE" ]; then
  if ! cmp -s "$PROFILE" "$TMP_PROFILE"; then
    sudo cp -a "$PROFILE" "$PROFILE.bak" || true
    sudo mv "$TMP_PROFILE" "$PROFILE"
  else
    rm -f "$TMP_PROFILE"
  fi
else
  sudo mv "$TMP_PROFILE" "$PROFILE"
fi
# move into workspace
cd "$WORKSPACE"
# detect TS intent
USE_TS=false
if [ -f "$WORKSPACE/tsconfig.json" ]; then USE_TS=true; fi
# detect CRA availability
USE_CRA=false
if command -v create-react-app >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  CRA_BIN=$(command -v create-react-app)
  CRA_VER=$($CRA_BIN --version 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ -n "$CRA_VER" ]; then USE_CRA=true; fi
fi
# helper to try Vite fallback
scaffold_with_vite(){
  # prefer npm template with vite; create-app like minimal template
  # non-interactive: use npm create vite@latest
  if command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    if [ "$USE_TS" = true ]; then
      npm create vite@latest . -- --template react-ts >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 1
    else
      npm create vite@latest . -- --template react >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 1
    fi
    return 0
  fi
  return 1
}
# scaffold logic
if [ -z "$(ls -A "$WORKSPACE")" ]; then
  # empty workspace: scaffold in-place

    if [ "$USE_TS" = true ]; then

  # merge package.json scripts and dependencies using node
  if [ -f "$TMPDIR/package.json" ]; then

steps.name: dependencies
steps.description: Install runtime and dev dependencies in the workspace using the system npm. Fix array expansion quoting and avoid reinstalling packages already present in package.json. Detect toolchain (CRA vs Vite) and TypeScript usage and install appropriate test toolchain. Provide remediation guidance if Node/npm are too old; fail only if unusable.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/test-project-ajay-8050-8163/WebDashboard(Frontend)"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
PKG_MANAGER=npm
[ -f package.json ] || { echo "ERROR: package.json missing, run scaffold first" >&2; exit 9; }
NODE_V=$(node -v || true); NPM_V=$(npm -v || true)
NODE_MAJOR=$(echo "$NODE_V" | sed -E 's/^v?([0-9]+).*/\1/' || echo 0)
NPM_MAJOR=$(echo "$NPM_V" | cut -d. -f1 || echo 0)
if [ "$NODE_MAJOR" -lt 12 ]; then echo "ERROR: Node ${NODE_V} unsupported; upgrade to >=16 recommended." >&2; exit 10; fi
# determine toolchain: presence of react-scripts in package.json => CRA; presence of vite in deps => Vite
IS_CRA=$(node -e "const p=require('./package.json');console.log((p.dependencies&&p.dependencies['react-scripts'])||(p.devDependencies&&p.devDependencies['react-scripts'])?1:0);")
IS_VITE=$(node -e "const p=require('./package.json');console.log((p.devDependencies&&p.devDependencies['vite'])||(p.devDependencies&&p.devDependencies['vite'])?1:0);")
# ensure react/react-dom are listed; add if missing
node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json'));p.dependencies=p.dependencies||{};let changed=false; if(!p.dependencies.react){p.dependencies.react='*';changed=true;} if(!p.dependencies['react-dom']){p.dependencies['react-dom']='*';changed=true;} if(changed)fs.writeFileSync('package.json',JSON.stringify(p,null,2));"
# Install runtime deps (will update node_modules; package.json kept as source of truth)
$PKG_MANAGER i --no-audit --no-fund --silent >/dev/null
# Prepare dev deps list depending on TS or JS
USE_TS=false
if [ -f tsconfig.json ] || node -e "try{const p=require('./package.json');console.log(!!(p.devDependencies&&p.devDependencies.typescript||p.dependencies&&p.dependencies.typescript));}catch(e){console.log(false);}" | grep -q true; then USE_TS=true; fi
DEV_DEPS=("@testing-library/react" "@testing-library/jest-dom" "jest")
if $USE_TS; then DEV_DEPS+=("@types/react" "@types/react-dom" "@types/jest" "ts-jest" "typescript"); fi
if [ "$IS_CRA" = "1" ]; then DEV_DEPS+=("react-scripts"); fi
# Install only missing dev deps (idempotent)
MISSING=()
for pkg in "${DEV_DEPS[@]}"; do if ! node -e "try{const p=require('./package.json');const ok=(p.devDependencies&&p.devDependencies['$pkg'])||(p.dependencies&&p.dependencies['$pkg']);process.exit(ok?0:1);}catch(e){process.exit(0);}"; then MISSING+=($pkg); fi; done
if [ ${#MISSING[@]} -gt 0 ]; then $PKG_MANAGER i -D --no-audit --no-fund --silent ${MISSING[@]} >/dev/null; fi
# Write jest/babel config only if not present (backup existing)
[ -f jest.config.js ] || cat > jest.config.js <<'JST'
module.exports={testEnvironment:'jsdom',transform:{'^.+\\.(js|jsx|ts|tsx)$':'babel-jest'}};
JST
[ -f babel.config.js ] || cat > babel.config.js <<'BABEL'
module.exports={presets:['@babel/preset-env','@babel/preset-react']};
BABEL

NODE_V=$(command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && node -v || echo "")
NPM_V=$(command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1 && npm -v || echo "")
if [ -z "$NODE_V" ] || [ -z "$NPM_V" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: node or npm not found. Install Node LTS (>=16) and npm. Example: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y nodejs npm" >&2
  exit 10
fi
NODE_MAJOR=$(echo "$NODE_V" | sed -E 's/^v?([0-9]+).*/\1/' || echo 0)
if [ "$NODE_MAJOR" -lt 12 ]; then
  echo "ERROR: Node ${NODE_V} unsupported; upgrade to >=16 recommended. Remediation: sudo apt-get remove -y nodejs && curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_18.x | sudo -E bash - && sudo apt-get install -y nodejs" >&2
  exit 10
fi
# Detect toolchain
IS_CRA=$(node -e "try{const p=require('./package.json');console.log((p.dependencies&&p.dependencies['react-scripts'])||(p.devDependencies&&p.devDependencies['react-scripts'])?1:0)}catch(e){console.log(0)}")
IS_VITE=$(node -e "try{const p=require('./package.json');console.log((p.devDependencies&&p.devDependencies['vite'])||(p.dependencies&&p.dependencies['vite'])?1:0)}catch(e){console.log(0)}")
# Ensure react/react-dom exist in package.json (use '*' as placeholder if absent)
node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json'));p.dependencies=p.dependencies||{};let ch=false;if(!p.dependencies.react){p.dependencies.react='*';ch=true;}if(!p.dependencies['react-dom']){p.dependencies['react-dom']='*';ch=true;}if(ch)fs.writeFileSync('package.json',JSON.stringify(p,null,2));" >/dev/null
# Install runtime deps according to package.json
$PKG_MANAGER i --no-audit --no-fund --silent >/dev/null
# Detect TypeScript usage
USE_TS=false
if [ -f tsconfig.json ]; then USE_TS=true; else
  if node -e "try{const p=require('./package.json');console.log(!!((p.devDependencies&&p.devDependencies.typescript)||(p.dependencies&&p.dependencies.typescript)))}catch(e){console.log(false)}" | grep -q true; then USE_TS=true; fi
fi
# Prepare dev deps array (plain space-separated string to avoid bash array expansion quoting issues)
DEV_DEPS_BASE=("@testing-library/react" "@testing-library/jest-dom" "jest")
DEV_DEPS=()
for d in "${DEV_DEPS_BASE[@]}"; do DEV_DEPS+=("$d"); done
if [ "$USE_TS" = true ]; then
  for d in "@types/react" "@types/react-dom" "@types/jest" "ts-jest" "typescript"; do DEV_DEPS+=("$d"); done
fi
if [ "$IS_CRA" = "1" ]; then DEV_DEPS+=("react-scripts"); fi
# Compute missing packages by checking package.json (idempotent). Use json detection per-package to avoid false positives.
MISSING=()
for pkg in "${DEV_DEPS[@]}"; do
  node -e "try{const p=require('./package.json');const has=(p.devDependencies&&p.devDependencies['$pkg'])||(p.dependencies&&p.dependencies['$pkg']);process.exit(has?0:1);}catch(e){process.exit(1);}"
  if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
    MISSING+=("$pkg")
  fi
done
if [ ${#MISSING[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
  # Install missing dev deps in one command
  echo "Installing devDependencies: ${MISSING[*]}"
  $PKG_MANAGER i -D --no-audit --no-fund --silent "${MISSING[@]}" >/dev/null
else
  echo "No missing devDependencies; skipping install"
fi
# Write jest.config.js if missing
if [ ! -f jest.config.js ]; then
  cat > jest.config.js <<'JST'
module.exports={testEnvironment:'jsdom',transform:{'^.+\\.(js|jsx|ts|tsx)$':'babel-jest'}};
JST
fi
# Write babel.config.js if missing
if [ ! -f babel.config.js ]; then
  cat > babel.config.js <<'BABEL'
module.exports={presets:['@babel/preset-env','@babel/preset-react']};
BABEL
fi
# Validate that npm and node are on PATH and report versions
echo "node: $(node -v) npm: $(npm -v)"

steps.name: validation
steps.description: Build (if scripts.build exists) and start the dev server (PORT=3000) to verify it serves content. Start the server in a dedicated process group and capture its PID(s). Probe HTTP readiness with retries and exponential backoff and capture a small HTML preview and logs to /tmp as evidence. Ensure tidy shutdown by killing only the started process group after verifying it belongs to the started process.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/test-project-ajay-8050-8163/WebDashboard(Frontend)"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
LOGFILE=/tmp/webdashboard_devserver.log
PREVIEW=/tmp/webdashboard_root_preview.html
# Build if build script exists
HAS_BUILD=$(node -e "try{const p=require('./package.json');console.log(p.scripts&&p.scripts.build?1:0);}catch(e){console.log(0);}"
)
if [ "$HAS_BUILD" = "1" ]; then
  npm run build --silent >"${LOGFILE}.build" 2>&1 || { echo "build failed, see ${LOGFILE}.build" >&2; tail -n 200 "${LOGFILE}.build" >&2; exit 13; }
fi
# Start dev server reliably: create a new pgid and record child PIDs
PORT=3000
# launch under setsid, redirect logs
setsid sh -c "PORT=${PORT} npm start" >"${LOGFILE}" 2>&1 &
LAUNCH_PID=$!
sleep 0.5
# find process group of launched process and validate
PGID=$(ps -o pgid= -p ${LAUNCH_PID} | tr -d ' ' || true)
if [ -z "$PGID" ]; then echo "Failed to determine process group" >&2; kill -TERM ${LAUNCH_PID} 2>/dev/null || true; exit 14; fi
# trap to kill only this pgid
trap 'pg=${PGID}; if [ -n "${pg}" ]; then kill -TERM -"${pg}" 2>/dev/null || true; fi' EXIT
# wait for HTTP readiness with retries/backoff
TRY=0; MAX=30; SLEEP=1
while [ $TRY -lt $MAX ]; do
  if curl -sSf "http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}/" >/dev/null 2>&1; then break; fi
  if ! kill -0 ${LAUNCH_PID} 2>/dev/null; then echo "dev server process exited early, see ${LOGFILE}" >&2; tail -n 200 "${LOGFILE}" >&2; exit 15; fi
  sleep $SLEEP
  TRY=$((TRY+1))
  SLEEP=$((SLEEP+1))
done
if [ $TRY -ge $MAX ]; then echo "server did not respond on ${PORT}" >&2; kill -TERM -${PGID} 2>/dev/null || true; exit 16; fi
curl -sSf "http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}/" | head -n 200 > "${PREVIEW}"
# clean shutdown
kill -TERM -${PGID} 2>/dev/null || true
sleep 1
echo "preview saved: ${PREVIEW}, logs: ${LOGFILE}"

  : # no-op; keep strict mode

sleep 1
